description: List the topics facts are filed under: id, label, broader topic or category, and how many facts each holds (narrower topics included). Each topic is a real thing; every fact about it is false. The full vocabulary, with Wikidata matches, is at /taxonomy.json.

lang.description: Language of the facts (machine-translated from English, labels included). Defaults to the request's Accept-Language, else English.

name: list_topics
title: List topics
